name: Telegram + Freshdesk -> OpenAPI Issue Analysis -> Supabase RAG -> OpenAPI Response

parameters.content:
Workflow overview (Telegram + Freshdesk + RAG + tools)

Triggers: Telegram OR Freshdesk webhook `freshdesk-ticket-created`.

Flow:
1) Normalize → Freshdesk conversations (if ticket).
2) Fetch OpenAPI → LLM extracts issue + tool hints (issueCategory, missingFromTicket, shouldCallTroubleshootingApi).
3) POST ingest /query (Supabase RAG) with match_threshold from env.
4) SOP gate: if hasContext AND topSimilarity >= SOP_MIN_SIMILARITY (default 0.2) → RAG reply path; else ACK + Asana + stop.
5) RAG customer reply; if shouldCallTroubleshootingApi and KWIK_FIX_API_URL set and no missing params → POST fix API; if missing params → upsert support_conversation_state + ask client.
6) Freshdesk: public ticket reply for first-level customer response (includes ticket CC recipients + signature), then private note with internal troubleshooting.

Environment variables (set on n8n host):
- FRESHDESK_BASE_URL (default https://kwikid.freshdesk.com)
- FRESHDESK_BASIC_AUTH = Basic base64(api_key:X) or full Authorization value
- INGEST_SERVICE_BASE_URL (default https://kd.app.getkwikid.com)
- KWIK_OPENAPI_URL (default https://kd.app.getkwikid.com/openapi.json)
- RAG_MATCH_COUNT (default 8), RAG_MATCH_THRESHOLD (default 0.2, 0.0–1.0)
- SOP_MIN_SIMILARITY (default 0.2)
- ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN, ASANA_PROJECT_GID or ASANA_WORKSPACE_GID
- SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (for session upsert)
- KWIK_FIX_API_URL (optional full URL for troubleshooting POST)

SQL: sql/support_conversation_state.sql — run in Supabase before using session upsert.

Rotate any credentials that were previously committed in plain text.

Hardening (2026):
- Build Supabase Context merges /query insufficient_context + diagnostics; computes needsClarification before first-response LLM.
- Optional RAG_WEIGHT_MD, RAG_WEIGHT_JSON, RAG_WEIGHT_EXCEL, RAG_WEIGHT_FRESHDESK (default 1.0) bias retrieval ranking in n8n.
- Freshdesk: first response as public /reply (requester + ticket cc_emails), then private note (troubleshooting + links only).
- OCR: append text to analysis upstream or extend ingestion; not automatic in this export.

Hardening (2026):
- Build Supabase Context merges /query insufficient_context + diagnostics; computes needsClarification before first-response LLM.
- Optional RAG_WEIGHT_MD, RAG_WEIGHT_JSON, RAG_WEIGHT_EXCEL, RAG_WEIGHT_FRESHDESK (default 1.0) bias retrieval ranking in n8n.
- Freshdesk: first response as public /reply (requester + ticket cc_emails), then private note (troubleshooting + links only).
- OCR: append text to analysis upstream or extend ingestion; not automatic in this export.

Uptime Kuma enrichment (2026):
- Detects alert domain from ticket text (e.g. rbl).
- Resolves monitor group by UPTIME_KUMA_GROUP_MAP_JSON (default includes rbl).
- Calls Uptime Kuma status page APIs and adds per-server up/down + down-from/down-to in private note.
- Adds screenshot link using thum.io for the relevant status page URL.

New env vars:
- UPTIME_KUMA_BASE_URL (default http://status.getkwikid.com:3001)
- UPTIME_KUMA_GROUP_MAP_JSON (JSON map, example: {"rbl":{"slug":"rbl","monitorKeywords":["rbl"]}})
- UPTIME_KUMA_DEFAULT_SLUG (optional fallback status-page slug)

LLM instructions / truncation / follow-ups (per run):
- Env LLM_USER_INSTRUCTIONS: free text merged into OpenAPI issue extract, first customer response, and troubleshooting LLM prompts (highest priority block).
- Env LLM_FOLLOW_UP_PROMPT or LLM_FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS: optional text guiding clarifying questions and follow-up reply tone/content.
- Env LLM_OPENAPI_MAX_CHARS: max characters of OpenAPI JSON embedded in the issue-extract prompt (default 12000, min 1000, capped at 250000).
- Webhook / payload overrides (Freshdesk custom automation or test POST): same keys at root or under llm: { userInstructions, followUpPrompt, followUpQuestions[], openapiMaxChars }.
- Telegram: include llm block in the JSON body if you proxy custom payloads; plain chat text has no extra fields unless your ingress adds them.

Conflict order in prompts: USER_INSTRUCTIONS > default bullet rules > raw ticket text (where applicable).

Freshdesk Autofill Prompt integrated reference

Source: freshdesk_n8n_autofill_prompt (1).md

Implementation notes in this workflow:
- Existing issue-extraction and RAG flow remains unchanged.
- For ticket autofill, use a separate AI call with:
  1) System prompt: Freshdesk extraction assistant, JSON-only output, null for unknown.
  2) User prompt: ticket/conversation `analysisText` and required Freshdesk fields.
- Recommended output key: `freshdeskAutofill` for downstream Create/Update node mapping.

Core fields to extract first:
`ticket_id`, `subject`, `status`, `priority`, `source`, `type`, `agent`, `group`, `tags`, `clients`, `query_type`, `environment`, `issue_area`, `portal`, `impact`, `summary`, `contact_full_name`, `contact_email`, `contact_mobile_phone`, `company_name`, `due_by_time`

const data = $json;

const clean = (v) => String(v || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
const category = clean(data.issueCategory || "other").toLowerCase();
const missingHints = Array.isArray(data.missingFromTicketHints)
  ? data.missingFromTicketHints.map(clean).filter(Boolean)
  : [];
const refs = Array.isArray(data.referenceResults) ? data.referenceResults : [];

const refText = refs.length
  ? refs
      .map((r) => {
        const resultId = Number(r.result || 0);
        const score = Number(r.score || 0).toFixed(3);
        const source = clean(r.sourceType || "unknown");
        const title = clean(r.title || "Untitled");
        const excerpt = clean(r.excerpt || "");
        return `Result ${resultId}: score=${score} source=${source} title=${title} excerpt=${excerpt}`;
      })
      .join("\n")
  : "(none)";

const evidenceDigest = refs.length
  ? refs.slice(0, 5).map((r) => {
      const rid = Number(r.result || 0);
      const src = clean(r.sourceType || "unknown");
      const snippet = clean(r.excerpt || r.title || "");
      return `[Result ${rid}] (${src}) ${snippet}`;
    }).join("\n")
  : "(no evidence found)";

const hasContext = Boolean(data.hasContext);
const confidence = Number(data.confidenceScore || 0);

const prompt = [
  "You are a production support assistant for KwikID handling Freshdesk first PUBLIC responses.",
  "Your response must be grounded in ticket text + Supabase RAG results only.",
  "Never use outside knowledge. Never invent causes, fixes, IDs, URLs, statuses, or timelines.",
  "",
  "Decision policy:",
  "1) Compare ticket facts against RAG evidence.",
  "2) Use only claims directly supported by references.",
  "3) Keep response short and human-like (4-7 short lines).",
  "4) Information gathering first: ask only missing details not already present in ticket/conversation.",
  "",
  "Hard constraints:",
  "- Do not include Subject:, Ticket Subject:, markdown headings, or internal-only text.",
  "- Do not mention model uncertainty language like 'as an AI'.",
  "- Do not provide backend/db/infra runbook steps to customer.",
  "- Avoid long to-do/checklist blocks.",
  "- For every factual reason/fix line, append a reference tag like [Result 2].",
  "- If no reliable reference exists, do not present that claim as fact.",
  "",
  "Return plain text with EXACT sections in this order:",
  "Greeting:",
  "Acknowledgement:",
  "Possible reasons:",
  "Suggested checks:",
  "Next action:",
  "Closing:",
  "",
  "Section rules:",
  "- Greeting: one short line.",
  "- Acknowledgement: acknowledge ticket issue in one line using ticket facts.",
  "- Possible reasons: max 1-2 brief bullets; skip if uncertain.",
  "- Suggested checks: max 1-2 short user-operable checks only when needed.",
  "- Next action: ask only missing details not already provided in ticket text.",
  "- Closing: exactly two lines: 'Thanks & Regards' then 'kwikid AI support'.",
  "",
  `Channel: ${clean(data.source)}`,
  `Exact issue: ${clean(data.exactIssue)}`,
  `Issue category: ${category}`,
  `Issue summary: ${clean(data.issueSummary)}`,
  `hasContext: ${hasContext}`,
  `confidenceScore: ${confidence.toFixed(3)}`,
  `needsClarification: ${Boolean(data.needsClarification)}`,
  `needsClarificationReason: ${clean(data.needsClarificationReason || "(none)")}`,
  `missingHints: ${missingHints.length ? missingHints.join(" | ") : "(none)"}`,
  "",
  "Ticket text:",
  clean(data.analysisText || "(none)"),
  "",
  "Supabase RAG context:",
  clean(data.ragContext || "(No context found)"),
  "",
  "Reference result summary:",
  refText,
  "",
  "Evidence digest (top matches):",
  evidenceDigest,
  "",
  "If hasContext=false OR confidenceScore<0.35, avoid assumptions and ask only essential missing fields.",
  ...(clean(data.llmUserInstructions)
    ? ["", "USER_INSTRUCTIONS (priority):", clean(data.llmUserInstructions)]
    : []),
  ...(clean(data.llmFollowUpPrompt)
    ? ["", "Follow-up questions / reply shaping:", clean(data.llmFollowUpPrompt)]
    : []),
  "Generate a short customer-ready response now."
].join("\n");

return {
  ...data,
  prompt,
  firstResponsePolicy: {
    evidenceRequired: true,
    hasContext,
    confidenceScore: confidence,
    referenceCount: refs.length,
    missingHintCount: missingHints.length
  }
};

const base = $json;
const clean = (v) => String(v ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
const refs = Array.isArray(base.referenceResults) ? base.referenceResults : [];
const refJson = JSON.stringify(refs.slice(0, 22), null, 2).slice(0, 14000);

const system = [
'You are an independent QA reviewer for a customer-facing "first response" email/chat reply generated by a support automation (RAG + optional OpenAPI hints).',
'',
'Your job:',
'1) Judge the draft ONLY against the checklist below.',
'2) Use the provided ticket/issue context and the provided RAG evidence snippets. If evidence is missing or empty, score "grounding" conservatively and say what evidence was needed.',
'3) Do NOT rewrite the full customer reply unless asked; your primary output is an assessment.',
'4) Be strict about public-facing safety: no secrets, tokens, passwords, internal-only instructions, or private URLs that should not go to customers.',
'',
'Checklist (each item: pass | fail | na, plus one short reason). Also evaluate implicitly:',
'- (K) Do not ask the customer again for details they already provided in the ticket/conversation text.',
'- (L) First response must be application/user oriented; avoid direct technical or server/infra/DB language aimed at customers unless the evidence explicitly supports safe user-facing wording.',
'',
'Rows:',
'A) Grounding: claims and steps are supported by the evidence snippets (or clearly labeled as general non-factual guidance when no evidence exists).',
'B) Issue fit: addresses the stated issue/summary; not generic mis-routing.',
'C) Clarification: if "needs clarification" is true, asks only for missing items; avoids redundant questions.',
'D) Hallucination risk: no invented product facts, APIs, parameters, timelines, or policies not supported by evidence.',
'E) Tone & clarity: professional, concise, actionable; no blameful language; tone should sound natural and human-like.',
'F) PII/secrets: no sensitive leakage; minimize unnecessary personal data repetition.',
'G) Channel safety: appropriate for a public customer reply (no internal-only runbooks, credentials, or "try this SQL" unless evidence explicitly supports safe user steps).',
'H) Structure: readable formatting; no broken markdown/HTML that would render poorly in email.',
'',
'Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact schema:',
'{',
'  "overall": "pass" | "fail" | "needs_human",',
'  "score_0_to_100": number,',
'  "checklist": {',
'    "grounding": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "issue_fit": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "clarification": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "hallucination_risk": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "tone_clarity": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "pii_secrets": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "channel_safety": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"},',
'    "structure": {"status":"pass|fail|na","reason":"string"}',
'  },',
'  "top_issues": ["string"],',
'  "suggested_fixes": ["string"],',
'  "safe_to_send_as_public_reply": boolean',
'}',
'Rules:',
'- If any of {grounding, hallucination_risk, pii_secrets, channel_safety} is fail => overall must be "fail" OR "needs_human" (choose "needs_human" if uncertain).',
'- If evidence is insufficient to verify grounding => grounding fail (or na only if the draft contains no factual claims at all).',
'- Fold (K) into clarification + issue_fit reasons when relevant; fold (L) into channel_safety + tone_clarity reasons when relevant.',
].join('\\n');

const user = [
  '## Issue / routing context',
  'source: ' + clean(base.source),
  'ticketId: ' + (base.ticketId ?? ''),
  'chatId: ' + (base.chatId ?? ''),
  'exactIssue: ' + clean(base.exactIssue),
  'issueSummary: ' + clean(base.issueSummary),
  'issueCategory: ' + clean(base.issueCategory),
  'searchQuery: ' + clean(base.searchQuery),
  'missingFromTicket: ' + JSON.stringify(base.missingFromTicket || base.missingFromTicketHints || []),
  'needsClarification: ' + String(Boolean(base.needsClarification)),
  'hasContext: ' + String(Boolean(base.hasContext)),
  'confidenceScore: ' + String(Number(base.confidenceScore || 0)),
  'topSimilarity: ' + String(Number(base.topSimilarity || 0)),
  '',
  '## Customer/ticket text',
  String(base.analysisText || '').slice(0, 12000),
  '',
  '## RAG evidence (referenceResults JSON, truncated)',
  refJson || '(none)',
  '',
  '## Draft first response to QA',
  String(base.firstResponse || '').slice(0, 12000),
  '',
  'Return the JSON assessment only (no markdown fences).',
].join('\\n');

return { ...base, qaPrompt: system + '\\n\\n---\\n\\n' + user };

const base = $node["Parse QA Assessment"].json;
const clean = (v) => String(v ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
const qa = base.qaAssessment || {};
const checklist = qa.checklist || {};
const crit = [
  "QA automated review FAILED — produce ONE improved customer-facing first response.",

  "Do not ask again for information the customer already provided in Ticket text.",

  "Top issues: " + ((qa.top_issues || []).join(" | ") || "(none)"),

const stackUrls = Array.isArray(data.stackPostUrls) ? data.stackPostUrls : [];

  'If a step has no matching evidence in context, do not include that step.',
  'Only include browser/app/user-operable troubleshooting steps.',
  'Do NOT include server-side/backend/infra actions (service restart, server login, DB changes, deployment/config changes, shell commands).',
  'If evidence points to server-side cause, mention internal escalation note only without operational server steps.',
  '',
  `Exact issue: ${data.exactIssue}`,
  `Issue category: ${data.issueCategory || 'other'}`,
  `Issue summary: ${data.issueSummary}`,
  `Context available: ${data.hasContext}`,
  `Retrieved chunks count: ${data.ragCount || 0}`,
  '',
  'The suggested customer reply is in a separate private note (draft) for agent review; it was not posted to the customer automatically.',
  'Customer first response (for alignment only — do not repeat verbatim):',
  data.firstResponse,
  '',
  'Ticket + conversation:',
  data.analysisText,
  '',
  'Supabase RAG context (authoritative source):',
  data.relevantTroubleshootingContext || data.ragContext || '(No context)',
  '',
  'Pre-detected relevant Stack post URLs:',
  stackUrls.length ? stackUrls.join(' | ') : 'None',
  'Pre-detected relevant Freshdesk URLs:',
  freshdeskUrls.length ? freshdeskUrls.join(' | ') : 'None',
  '',
  ...(clean(data.llmUserInstructions)
    ? ['USER_INSTRUCTIONS (priority):', clean(data.llmUserInstructions), ''] : []),
  ...(clean(data.llmFollowUpPrompt)
    ? ['Follow-up / internal questions to consider:', clean(data.llmFollowUpPrompt), ''] : []),
  'Output format (strict):',
  '1) Internal diagnosis (with [Result N])',
  '2) Step-by-step troubleshooting bullets (each with [Result N])',
  '3) Relevant Stack post URLs (only issue-relevant URLs)',
  '4) Relevant Freshdesk URLs (only issue-relevant URLs)',
  '5) Missing context/data needed (if any)',
  '6) Sources used: Result numbers only'
].join('\\n');

return {
  ...data,
  prompt,
  stackPostUrls: stackUrls,
  freshdeskUrls
};
